prompts.grass: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production seamless GRASS GROUND texture tile for the attached 2D Castaway game. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE only. Closely match its beautifully detailed grass and exposed earth around Tomas in the centre-left. Square full-bleed opaque image, entirely a horizontal ground material, NO scene, trees, bushes, large plants, rocks, buildings, characters, paths or objects. A softly irregular mixture of sage/olive/meadow grass and small patches of warm sandy ochre soil, with many tiny hand-clustered blade pixels and occasional tiny gold/copper fallen leaf flecks. The ground must feel hand crafted and naturally varied, with small interlocking crisp pixel colour shapes and a restrained palette. Fine premium adventure game pixel art, carefully grouped detail, sunlight from upper left. Match the reference: warmer olive and gold, never neon green or gray. Uniform illumination and scale across the image, no large central clearing, gradients, blur, photographic noise, brush strokes, vignette, shadow cast by objects, text or labels. Four sides must join seamlessly for tiling. Target downsample 384 x 384 pixels; details should remain crisp and legible. Pure repeatable ground texture only.
prompts.tomas-heads: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent character HEAD sprite atlas for the attached Castaway PC game. Row1 right: head tilted slightly down, gaze down-right. Row2 left: eyes closed, restful. Row2 right: eyes open but tired, slightly pale skin. HEAD AND SHORT NECK ONLY; no shoulders, body, hands, clothing, accessories, hats, portrait medallion, square backdrop, ground, shadows, labels or text. Rounded organic head, not a circular icon or large cartoon face. No heavy black outline. Target each final head only 27 x 27 pixels in game; make it readable at that scale. Genuine RGBA transparent background, no checkerboard.
